units.text: That we were able to lower our operating expenses while increasing revenue is a testament to the industry-leading revenue per employee that we maintain.
Efficiency is a key selling point of what we provide to our customers.
We mirror this focus on our own internal operations.
Moreover, our transition to a SaaS model has reached the point where we no longer need to aggressively invest in our own infrastructure to support our scale.
Incremental revenue is disproportionately falling to the bottom line, and our contribution margin continues to increase.
